name: private-research-notebook
description: A private research notebook: index local sources, answer with citations, export an evidence brief and a deck, audit the gaps.

commands.name: notebook-build
commands.description: Index local files into a private source notebook
commands.template: Build a source notebook from the local files in: {input}. Use create_source_notebook with the supplied paths; do not invent paths.

commands.name: notebook-ask
commands.description: Answer a question only from indexed notebook evidence
commands.template: Answer from the source notebook: {input}. Use query_source_notebook and cite every grounded claim as [Sxxx-Cxxx].

commands.name: notebook-brief
commands.description: Export a source brief with an evidence register
commands.template: Export a source brief from the notebook: {input}. Use export_source_brief and list the evidence register and open gaps.

commands.name: notebook-deck
commands.description: Turn the evidence into a PPTX deck with citations
commands.template: Build a deck from the source notebook: {input}. Use create_pptx_deck with one claim per slide and a citation in the speaker notes.

commands.name: notebook-audit
commands.description: Audit citation coverage and name unsupported claims
commands.template: Audit the notebook evidence for: {input}. List supported claims, unsupported claims and missing sources; cite chunk IDs.

changelog: 1.0.0 - Private Research Notebook: five-command local evidence suite with citation contract and gap audit.
